title: Restaurant owners and staff protest in Sofia
reason: Out of month: the consulted BNR body dates the Sofia owners/staff assembly to January 27, before the February unit. The February 1 date is a requested reopening date, not a separate protest date.
notes: S010 was opened in the January 2021 dossier and consulted for month-boundary review. It reports the January 27 gathering outside the Council of Ministers. No separate February 1 assembly is established by this body; no attendee, demand or response data is transferred to a February event.
